outcome: composite adverse perinatal outcome (fetal, neonatal, or infant death)
cohort: A cohort of 171 normally grown, euploid singleton fetuses with congenital heart disease (CHD) from a single academic center.
finding: Umbilical artery (UA) Doppler assessment was found to be unlikely to predict adverse perinatal outcome in normally grown, euploid singleton fetuses with CHD.
birth_weight: normally grown (fetuses with growth restriction were excluded)
